summary: Retained receipt e7cdea5042e54182b277e185ae576ea8 (completed, exit 0) closes the last realism limitation with all eighteen comparisons complete and satisfied. The interpretation for experiment e42acd6803084697a022953fe797f2d4-experiment links all seven lineage receipts by joint history, records the running-clock observation as durable knowledge with its indices, replaces the no-ticks limitation with a narrower statement about the executed tick schedule, and marks the investigation's question explained since it is now answered end to end: no code path lets the re-added member's MsgProp traffic reach a decision while the gate is disarmed, and the held request is admitted only when an observed leader change re-arms it.
